theater: 陝西綏德大順城與甘肅熙河洮岷

battle.name: 西夏、吐蕃攻宋之戰
battle.theater: 陝西綏德大順城與甘肅熙河洮岷
battle.brief: 元祐二年，司馬光盡棄新法與開邊之策，夏人與吐蕃木征部遂在西北兩線並起：夏兵直逼陝西綏德、大順城，蕃兵陷甘肅熙河、洮岷，宋廷以堡寨固守、屯田且耕，和議遂成。同一年代的歐洲，維京長斧正隨丹麥、挪威船隊登陸英格蘭海岸——一柄窄刃長斧，兩岸同代的兵刃。

kit.name: 維京長斧
kit.history: 刃很長，斧面窄。北歐的船隊帶著它，也帶著它上岸。

countries: 北宋、西夏、吐蕃木征部三方在十一世紀末的西北邊疆彼此糾纏，實際的交戰拉在兩條戰線上。北宋方面，中央以樞密院掌兵、三衙領禁軍，陝西沿邊設永興軍路、秦鳳路、涇原路、熙河路四個經略司，經略司之下有馬步軍、弓箭手、蕃兵與壯勇，各城寨另置守軍兼營田；涇原管綏德、大順一線，熙河管熙、洮、岷、疊、宕諸州以及木征部原居的高地。西夏方面，兵權集中在興慶府的中樞密院，衙門分掌車馬、兵仗、廩食諸事，調兵以部族為單位，配步軍、騎軍與弩手，與宋西北軍鎮拉鋸多年，近來新得米脂、葭蘆諸寨的歸屬爭端正由此而起。吐蕃方面並無統一帝國，仍是大小部落的聯盟，與宋接壤者以熙河一帶的木征部（漢籍稱唃廝囉）勢力最大，能在山谷中騎兵往來、依附城邑而游走掠糧。三方並無正式盟約，夏、蕃在宋面前時而並進、時而各懷算計，這種鬆散協作也決定了攻勢的起訖並不一致。
countriesEn: Three parties - the Song, Xixia and the Muzheng clan of the Tibetans - were entangled on the north-west frontier of the eleventh century, and the actual fighting was pulled along two separate lines. On the Song side the Central Military Commission held command of the army and the Three Branches led the imperial guard, while four circuits with their own headquarters stood on the Shaanxi frontier: Yongxingjun, Qinfeng, Jingyuan and Xihe, each with cavalry and infantry, archers and crossbowmen, native militia and braves beneath it, and each walled town keeping its own garrison and its own fields. The Jingyuan circuit held the line of Suide and Dashun; the Xihe circuit governed the prefectures of Xi, Tao, Min, Die and Dang together with the upland pastures formerly occupied by the Tibetan clans. On the Xixia side the war was run from the capital at Xingqingfu, the Central Military Commission holding the military while the yamen dealt separately with horses, weapons and stores, troops raised by tribal levy and organised as foot, horse and crossbow units; the quarrel over the border forts of Mizhi and Jialu had been running for years precisely because of this system. The Tibetans had no unified empire at all but a loose league of clans, and of those bordering the Song the Muzheng party, called HuSiluo in the Chinese records, was by far the largest, able to ride through the valleys, shelter behind walled towns and sweep the grain roads. The three were never bound by a formal alliance: Xixia and the Tibetans advanced together in one season and went their separate ways in the next, and that loose cooperation explains why their offensives did not begin and end together.
people: 宋廷這邊做主的是垂簾聽政的宣仁聖烈皇后高氏，以及以司馬光為首的執政。司馬光在元祐改元之後主持盡棄新法、罷撤元豐開邊之役，把熙河新開之地與西夏邊寨一併交還或議讓，主張守禦為本、且耕且守，免得再蹈深入而失地的老路；文彥博、呂大防等同為主張安寧的執政，樞密院掌兵，卻與中書門下在用兵還是議和上屢有分歧。陝西真正與夏、蕃接觸的，是各路經略司與其下將校：熙河一線由經略使李璆等主持，一度退保洮、岷，再圖恢復；西夏那邊，君主李秉常年幼，母后梁氏專權，中樞密院與宗室爭議不休，遣使求和與整軍備戰同時進行；吐蕃木征部以首領木征（唃廝囉）為核心，其部眾或抗或附，分歧極大。同一時候，歐洲那邊也有可比的一角：挪威王馬格努斯於一〇八七年率挪威與丹麥船隊南入英格蘭，攻陷倫敦並縱火焚市，英格蘭人用長柄斧與短兵在街巷裡死守，那正是丹麥斧最晚的一次大規模亮相。
peopleEn: On the Song side the decisions belonged to the empress dowager Xuanren Shenglie, Gao, who governed as regent for the child emperor Zhezong, and to the ministers who worked with Sima Guang. After the Yuan-you era began, Sima Guang presided over the reversal of the New Policies and the abandonment of the Yuanfeng expansion, offering the newly opened lands of the Xihe region and the Xixia border forts as cards in a negotiation, on the principle that the frontier should be held rather than pushed, and farmed rather than fought for. Wen Yanbo, Lü Dajiang and the rest of the regency shared that preference for quiet; the Central Military Commission kept the army but disagreed often with the central secretariat over whether to fight or to negotiate. The men who actually met the Xixia and Tibetan parties in Shaanxi were the commanders of the circuit headquarters and their subordinates: at Xihe the circuit commissioner Li Qiu and his colleagues fell back to Tao and Min and then worked their way forward again. In the Xixia camp the ruler Li Bingchang was a boy and his mother, Lady Liang, held the real power, the central commission and the imperial clan quarrelled endlessly, and envoys seeking peace went out while the ordnance yards worked to arm the army. The Tibetan Muzheng party centred on its chief Muzheng, known in Chinese records as HuSiluo, and his followers were divided between resistance and submission. The same year offered a fair comparison elsewhere: King Magnus of Norway sailed south with Norwegian and Danish fleets, stormed London and fired the town, while the English fought in the streets with long-handled axes and short weapons - the last great appearance of the Dane axe.
kits: 卡面這件維京長斧不屬於任何一支參戰隊伍，它是十一世紀北歐的裝備，放在這張卡上，是同一個年代裡另一端的兵刃。形制上它是柄長約莫兩公尺、刃長六七十公分以上、斧面狹長的單刃斧：斧面窄而長，形如長鐮而非寬刃月斧，刃口微弧，斧背扁平，可以格擋，也常以雙手握柄作劈砍，砍中人身之後靠扭腕而不是拔劈的動作取斧。十一世紀上半葉，丹麥、挪威、瑞典的戰士以家庭為單位結隊，配這樣的長柄斧；一〇六六年斯坦福橋之役，挪威王哈拉爾麾下的戰士即持長柄斧對抗英格蘭軍，一〇八七年倫敦之役，同樣是這類斧兵在街巷中作戰。與之同時的中國西北邊防，用的完全是另一套裝備：宋軍步卒以皮甲、札甲為主，長柄刀與槊為主兵器，弓弩並用，其中神臂弓自記能洞穿鐵葉甲，弩手以床子弩、擘弩為重火力；守城用撞車、飛石、雲梯、猛火油櫃與火藥箭，《武經總要》所載的猛火油櫃即為此類；夏、蕃的騎兵則以刀、弓箭為主，長處在騎射與掠糧。兩地同處冷兵器技術的頂峰，卻走了城防技術與野戰重斧的兩條路。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card face, the Dane axe, belonged to none of the armies that fought in this war; it is the equipment of eleventh-century northern Europe, and it belongs on the card as the blade from the far end of the same century. In form it is a narrow single-bitted axe with a haft some two metres long and a blade more than sixty or seventy centimetres; the head is narrow and long, shaped like a long sickle rather than a broad moon-axe, the edge slightly curved and the back flat so that it could be used to parry, and it was normally gripped in both hands, cut driven by a swing of the shoulders and freed by a twist of the wrist rather than pulled back. In the first half of the eleventh century warriors from Denmark, Norway and Sweden banded together by household and carried such axes; at Stamford Bridge in 1066 the men of King Harald of Norway fought the English with long-handled axes, and in the fighting around London in 1087 the same kind of axe infantry fought in the streets. The Chinese north-west of the same decades used a completely different set of gear: Song infantry wore hide and lamellar armour and carried long-handled sabres and spears, with bows and crossbows used together, the divine strength crossbow being the heavy arm and the bed-nu crossbow and the stretch-armed crossbow the firepower of the defenders; siege work relied on rams, stone-throwers, scaling ladders, the cabinet of burning oil (meng huoyou) and gunpowder arrows, the burning-oil cabinet described in the Wujing Zongyao being exactly this sort of device; Xixia and Tibetan cavalry fought with sabres and bows, their strength lying in mounted archery and the plunder of grain. Both regions sat at the summit of the same technical band of the age of cold weapons, and yet they went by two roads, one toward the technology of defending walls, the other toward the heavy axe of open-field combat.
tactics: 宋廷這一年的戰法可以收、屯、撫三字概括：收，是不急著收復失地，先看現有城寨守不守得住；屯，是在熙河、涇原一線把營田與軍糧屯田重新做起，減少從長安、蜀中遠運的消耗；撫，是對吐蕃部眾給官、給地，能內附者收之，用以削弱木征部。作戰上，涇原線以綏德、大順等堡寨為核心，弓箭手與弩手登城，以火藥箭與猛火油櫃守城門城頭，夏騎逼近便以弩箭壓制，待其散亂再出城邀擊，重點不在斬首而在斷其糧道與牧地；熙河線因州縣多失，只守洮、岷一線的山口與渡口，把木征部阻在深山，同時遣使議和。西夏的打法仍是騎兵遊邊：先以數千至數萬的輕騎掠宋邊耕屯、斷驛道，再以步軍列陣攻城，但糧秣自遠方而來，攻宋城池往往不能持久，歷來夏人十日一易糧的說法就出在這類戰役裡；吐蕃部眾則靠熟悉山道的老到，遊走於宋夏之間，既依附城邑又劫掠田禾。三方都沒有一舉殲滅對手的手段，這是宋廷敢於以守待變的底氣。
tacticsEn: The Song method that year can be summed up in three words: hold, farm, pacify. Hold meant not rushing to recover lost ground but first establishing whether the existing strongholds could be defended at all. Farm meant rebuilding the military fields and the cultivated patches along the Jingyuan and Xihe lines so that the drain of grain hauled from Chang'an and from Sichuan eased. Pacify meant giving the Tibetan households rank and land and taking in those who would submit, so as to weaken the Muzheng party. In practice the Jingyuan line, with Suide, Dashun and the other forts as its core, put archers and crossbowmen on the walls, used gunpowder arrows and cabinets of burning oil to hold the gates and parapets, and when Xixia horse came close answered with crossbow volleys, waiting for the attackers to scatter before counterattacking from the gate; the aim was never to take a commander but to cut the enemy's grain road and pastures. The Xihe line, having lost most of its prefectures, held only the passes and fords of the Tao and Min valleys, kept the Muzheng party out in the high country, and sent envoys to negotiate. Xixia still fought the way it always had, with light horse riding the border, several thousand to several tens of thousands strong, sweeping the Song's fields and hamlets and cutting the courier roads, then bringing foot troops up in array to lay siege to the towns; but their food came from far away, so sieges of Song cities could never be prolonged, and the old saying that the Xixia changed their provisions every ten days grew out of campaigns of exactly this kind. The Tibetans relied on their mastery of the mountain tracks, riding between the Song and the Xixia, sheltering behind towns on one day and raiding the standing grain on the next. None of the three had a means of destroying an opponent in one stroke, and that was the confidence behind the Song policy of waiting behind walls.
data: 可核對的數字不多，只能就規模說個大概。北宋全軍常額在百萬上下，後期一度增至一百四十萬上下，其中陝西沿邊四路是禁軍與蕃兵最集中的地方，各路常額合計以數十萬計，分番更戍，無一日不在移動。熙河新開的熙、河、洮、岷、疊、宕六州之地，縱深數千里，蕃部大小數十，總眾以數十萬計，故此六州之得失被宋廷視為西北的門戶。西人每次出兵多在數千至數萬之間，以輕騎為主，深入遠征則極少；與宋往來的信使、歲賜與榷場貿易則有定數可查。距離上，涇原軍府至熙州約八百餘里，綏德至熙州的直線也在千里上下，消息最快也要十餘日才能送到——這是宋廷寧可議和、不願再深入的根本原因：遠在邊鎮的城守可以守，千里之外的戰場守不了。一〇八七年冬，挪威王馬格努斯率挪威與丹麥船隊南下，倫敦一炬，英格蘭全境震動，那一年的歐洲戰場上，斧兵的身影仍清晰可辨。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked are few, so only the scale can be given roughly. The Song army's authorised strength stood around a million men, rising to some 1.4 million in the later years of the dynasty, and the four circuits on the Shaanxi frontier held the densest concentration of imperial troops and native militia, their establishments running into the hundreds of thousands, relieved in rotation and never at rest. The six prefectures newly opened in the Xihe region - Xi, He, Tao, Min, Die and Dang - covered hundreds of li in depth, with dozens of Tibetan clans and populations counted in the tens of thousands, which is why the Song court treated them as the gateway of the north-west. Xixia armies, from a thousand to several tens of thousands strong, were mostly light horse, and expeditions into the far interior were rare; the exchanges with the Song, however, were regular and recorded, in envoys, annual gifts and the border markets. In distance, the Jingyuan headquarters lay some eight hundred li from Xihe and the direct line from Suide to Xihe was of the order of a thousand li, so news took more than ten days to travel - the plain reason the court preferred negotiation to any new advance: a garrison at the frontier can be held, a battlefield a thousand li away cannot. In the winter of 1087 King Magnus of Norway sailed south with Norwegian and Danish fleets and burned London, and the axe infantry of that year were still clearly visible on the European battlefield.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。最外層是宋廷自己換了手：宋神宗崩後，哲宗年幼，宣仁聖烈皇后高氏垂簾，司馬光執政，把熙寧、元豐二十年間的新法與開邊之策一併反轉，熙河與西夏邊寨的主意由攻轉守，甚至把新得的土地當作談判的籌碼。這一轉，邊境上的實力對比立刻改變：西夏以為宋廷軟弱可欺，吐蕃木征部以為能重奪熙河。第二層是西夏自身的困局：李秉常年幼、梁氏專權，內部宗室與權臣相爭，又連年旱災，戶口與馬匹銳減，既要向宋廷爭米脂、葭蘆諸寨的歸屬，又怕遼國趁虛再來，於是向宋開戰以壯聲勢。第三層是宋廷的財政與輿論：廢新法後國用稍舒，卻也失去募役、免役一類的收入，士大夫普遍不願再興大役，朝廷只能選擇議和為上、設防為本。三層疊在一起，遂有了元祐二年夏、蕃同時在西北兩線發兵的局面。
causeEn: There were three layers of cause. The outermost was a change of hands inside the Song court itself: after Emperor Shenzong died, Zhezong was a child, the empress dowager Xuanren Shenglie, Gao, took the regency, and with Sima Guang at the head of government the New Policies and the expansion of the Xining and Yuanfeng years were reversed together, so that the Xihe region and the Xixia border forts changed from a prize to be fought for into bargaining counters, and the frontier posture turned from offence to defence. That single reversal changed the balance on the frontier: Xixia read the court as weak and open to attack, and the Muzheng party of the Tibetans read the moment as a chance to retake the Xihe. The second layer was Xixia's own distress: Li Bingchang was a boy, Lady Liang held the power, the imperial clan and the ministers fought each other, and years of great drought had cut the households and the herds; needing the return of Mizhi and Jialu and fearing a fresh Liao attack from the north, Xixia chose to strike in order to strengthen its own hand. The third layer was the court's finances and its public mood: abolishing the New Policies eased the treasury but removed the revenue from corvee and service levy, and the scholar-officials in general would not consent to a new great campaign, so the court could choose only negotiation first and defence second. Layered together, these produced the situation in which Xixia and the Tibetans struck at the same time on two fronts in the north-west in the second year of Yuan-you.
impact: 影響是雙向的，而且都不小。對宋廷，短期是丟了地：熙河六州與西夏邊寨一併交出，邊界線往東退了一大截，涇原、秦鳳兩路的正面壓力大增，宋史把這段政策記作元祐更化的代價，士論批評與棄地二字相始終。長期看卻也換來一套防守的辦法：堡寨、屯田、招撫三件事被寫進後來的邊務，紹聖、崇寧再攻西夏與吐蕃時，熙河一路仍以州縣經營為底子，說明一〇八七年之後的西北戰略，是從守成的經驗裡長出來的。對西夏，得地不得人心，內部權鬥更烈，元祐末年梁氏失勢，李秉常與其後的襄宗相繼而亡，西夏此後十幾年再沒有能與宋廷分庭抗禮的元氣，只有在遼、宋之間左右逢源。對吐蕃木征部，熙河既失，部分部眾北附宋廷，宋給官給地，一部分西遷，一部分散為小部，吐蕃諸部自此再無能與宋夏同盟的統一力量，只餘零星侵擾。一〇八七年冬的倫敦之火則是北歐方面的對照：維京式的長柄斧兵最後一次大規模跨海作戰，此後北歐人把重心移回挪威本土，與英格蘭的爭端，要再等一百年後的另一種船才會重演。
impactEn: The effects ran in both directions, and neither was small. For the Song court the immediate cost was land: the six prefectures of Xihe and the Xixia border forts were handed over together, the frontier line moved a long way east, and the pressure on the Jingyuan and Qinfeng circuits rose sharply; the Song History records the price of this policy under the heading of the Yuan-you reversal, and the phrase of giving up ground has trailed the debate ever since. In the longer run, however, the court acquired a way of holding the border: forts, military fields and pacification were written into the frontier routine, and when the Song went on the offensive against Xixia and the Tibetans under Shaosheng and Chongning, the Xihe circuit still rested on prefectures managed as farms and garrisons - the north-west strategy after 1087 grew out of that experience of defence. For Xixia, gaining ground brought no loyalty, the struggle at court grew worse, and by the end of Yuan-you Lady Liang fell, Li Bingchang and his successor followed one another to the grave, and for the next decade or more Xixia had no vigour to hold its own against the Song, able only to hedge between Liao and Song. For the Muzheng party of the Tibetans, losing Xihe meant that part of its households submitted northward to the Song, which gave them rank and land, while others moved west or scattered into small clans; the Tibetan tribes from that point on had no unified force able to ally with the Song or the Xixia, only scattered raids. The fire of London in the winter of 1087 is the northern counterpoint: the Viking long-handled axemen made their last great crossing to fight abroad, and northern Europe turned its attention back to Norway at home; the quarrel with England would wait for a different kind of ship a century later.
result: 結果是打平。對宋，雙線攻勢都被擋在堡寨與弩箭之外，綏德、大順一線未失，夏人沒有能取下一座宋的州縣；然熙河六州仍然一度交到吐蕃手裡，宋廷其後花上兩三年光陰、經過數番出使議和，才陸續收復熙州與洮、岷、疊、宕諸州，熙河路重新接回；至於寨地歸屬，也在這段時間裡定案，米脂、葭蘆、浮圖諸寨歸西夏，寨數另有小異，諸說並存，宋朝換得邊界上的相對安定。對西夏，元祐二年雖在宋邊小挫，卻靠議和拿到了心心念念的寨地，得以喘一口氣；對吐蕃木征部，短期重得熙河舊地，卻失去部眾的凝聚，北宋一紙招撫、一紙賜地，把其中相當一部分人拉向宋朝。整體而言，一〇八七年這一輪的結果是：戰場上沒有決定性的勝負，政治上西夏與宋朝都沒有吃大虧，只有吐蕃諸部付出了最重的代價；此後二十餘年，西北邊界維持在不打大仗、各守其土的狀態，直到宋夏再啟新局。
resultEn: The result was a draw. For the Song, both offensives were held off by the forts and the crossbows; the line of Suide and Dashun was not taken, and the Xixia took no Song prefecture. The six prefectures of Xihe were nonetheless handed to the Tibetans for a time, and it took the Song two or three more years, and a series of embassies and negotiations, to recover Xihe and then Tao, Min, Die and Dang, restoring the Xihe circuit to Song hands; the question of the border forts was settled in the same period, with Mizhi, Jialu and Futu going to Xixia - the exact count of the forts varying in the records - and the Song buying a relative calm along the frontier. For Xixia, a small reverse against the Song frontier in the second year of Yuan-you was more than paid for by the treaty that delivered the forts it had coveted, and the state could draw breath. For the Muzheng party of the Tibetans, the old lands of Xihe were recovered in the short term, yet the cohesion of the clans was lost, and a single sheet of Song offers - rank and land for those who submitted - pulled a good part of them over to the Song. Overall, the round of 1087 produced no decisive battlefield victory; politically neither Xixia nor the Song lost heavily, and only the Tibetan tribes paid the heaviest price. For more than twenty years afterwards the north-west frontier stayed in a state of no great war, each side holding its own ground, until Song and Xixia opened a new round.
